details.title: Strategic Partnership Agreement
details.governing_law: laws of the State of Delaware
details.courts_or_seat: state or federal courts located in the City and County of San Francisco, California

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

details.parties_quote: Datavane, Inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 575 Market Street, Suite 2200, San Francisco, California 94105, USA ("Datavane"); and AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("Partner").

payment_source.quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.

details.services_summary: Implementation, migration, integration, managed and consulting services for the Datavane Platform

liability_cap.basis: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).
liability_cap.quote: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).

restrictive_covenants.summary: Partner cannot provide implementation services to Datavane Accounts for competing data platforms during term and 24 months after termination.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: provide implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any competing data platform
restrictive_covenants.quote: Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Partner grants Datavane a perpetual royalty‑free licence to use Partner’s feedback, connectors, templates and accelerators.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: grant licence to use any feedback, connectors, templates or implementation accelerators submitted by Partner
restrictive_covenants.quote: Partner hereby grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty‑free licence to use any feedback, connectors, templates or implementation accelerators that Partner submits to the Datavane Partner Marketplace.

findings.title: AtliQ Pvt Ltd named for a US client
findings.why: US clients contract with AtliQ Inc.
findings.comparison: Entity sheet: AtliQ Inc serves the United States only.
findings.quote: Datavane, Inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 575 Market Street, Suite 2200, San Francisco, California 94105, USA ("Datavane"); and AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("Partner").

findings.title: CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform
findings.why: Exclusivity restricts acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform in India and GCC regions.
findings.comparison: Do not partner with another cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse vendor in India or the GCC while the CloudSpan agreement runs.
findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 7.3: does not restrict services outside India and the GCC, or to a customer that independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and receives no fee from, that platform's provider.

findings.title: Broad definition captures existing clients as prospects
findings.why: AtliQ's pre-existing clients are treated as Datavane prospects if discussed.
findings.comparison: Exceeds standard partnership definitions by encompassing pre-existing client relationships.
findings.quote: whether or not such person or entity was an existing client of Partner prior to the Effective Date.

findings.title: Datavane account includes registered and introduced prospects
findings.why: Broadly claims introduced entities and their affiliates as Datavane Accounts.
findings.comparison: More restrictive than typical partner definitions found in past contracts.
findings.quote: (b) each Prospect registered by Partner through the Partner Portal, and (c) each Prospect introduced to Datavane by Partner in any manner, together with such entity's Affiliates.

findings.title: Existing Clients Converted to Datavane Accounts
findings.why: AtliQ's existing clients are absorbed into Datavane's account base upon registration.
findings.comparison: Clashes with AtliQ's protection of existing client relationships.
findings.quote: Where Partner proposes the Platform to an existing client of Partner, Partner shall register such client in the Partner Portal as a Prospect, whereupon such client shall become a Datavane Account.

findings.title: Broad Non-Compete and Post-Term Restriction
findings.why: Restricts AtliQ from providing alternative data platform services to registered clients during and for 24 months post-term.
findings.comparison: Exceeds standard non-compete limits and restricts AtliQ's business scope.
findings.quote: Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation... services to any Datavane Account... other than the Datavane Platform.

findings.title: Unilateral termination for convenience by Datavane
findings.why: Datavane can walk away on short notice, leaving AtliQ with no reciprocal right.
findings.comparison: Creates significant asymmetry in partnership commitments.
findings.quote: Datavane may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, upon fifteen (15) days' written notice to Partner.

findings.title: Partner denied termination for convenience
findings.why: AtliQ is locked in for 3-years with no exit for convenience, while Datavane can terminate at any time.
findings.comparison: Extremely one-sided restriction on AtliQ.
findings.quote: Partner may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term.

findings.title: Forfeiture of unpaid revenue share or referral fees
findings.why: AtliQ loses earned revenue shares or referral fees if the end client hasn't paid Datavane before termination.
findings.comparison: Violates the principle that AtliQ must be paid for work done.
findings.quote: no revenue share or referral fee shall be payable in respect of any Joint Deal or referral not fully paid by the relevant Datavane Account before the effective date of termination

findings.title: Perpetual license to AtliQ accelerators and connectors
findings.why: AtliQ permanently surrenders rights to its proprietary templates, connectors, and implementation accelerators.
findings.comparison: Conflicts with AtliQ keeping its pre-existing tools and accelerators.
findings.quote: Partner hereby grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use any feedback, connectors, templates or implementation accelerators that Partner submits

findings.title: Uncapped and one-sided indemnity by Partner
findings.why: AtliQ's indemnity obligations are broad, covering representations, acts of subcontractors, and accounts, with zero cap.
findings.comparison: Principles prefer mutual indemnity and proportional liability caps.
findings.quote: Partner's obligations under this Section 11.1 shall not be subject to any limitation or cap.

findings.title: Low liability cap for Datavane
findings.why: Limits Datavane's maximum exposure to a fixed low amount regardless of contract scale.
findings.comparison: AtliQ prefers liability proportionate to contract value (around 1x fees).
findings.quote: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY... SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).

findings.title: Exclusion from Partner liability cap
findings.why: AtliQ's liability is entirely uncapped for multiple sections, creating severe financial exposure.
findings.comparison: Exceeds standard 1x to 2x caps seen in past contracts.
findings.quote: NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT PARTNER'S LIABILITY UNDER SECTION 5, SECTION 9 OR SECTION 11.1.

findings.title: Unilateral amendments by Datavane
findings.why: Datavane can unilaterally change core program terms that bind AtliQ upon mere notice.
findings.comparison: Risks unvetted obligations being imposed during the 36-month term.
findings.quote: Datavane may update the Global Partner Program Guide, certification requirements and Partner Portal terms from time to time upon notice to Partner, and such updates shall form part of this Agreement.

findings.title: Indian entity under non-Indian law (laws of the State of Delaware)
findings.why: Disputes would be fought under foreign law and courts.
findings.comparison: Principle: India for AtliQ Pvt Ltd. Past exceptions (Al Noor DIFC, Northwind English law) were deliberate.
findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

findings.title: Payment in 60 days
findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
findings.comparison: Principle: 30 days, 45 at most.
findings.quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.

findings.title: Direct sales permitted to partner-registered prospects
findings.why: Datavane can compete directly for prospects that AtliQ registers and invests in.
findings.comparison: Unfavorable compared to standard partner protection terms.
findings.quote: and may sell directly to any Customer or Prospect, including Prospects registered by Partner.

findings.title: Mandatory Certified Personnel throughout Term
findings.why: Imposes ongoing fixed operational costs and staffing commitments on AtliQ regardless of deal flow.
findings.comparison: Not typically found in standard IT services agreements.
findings.quote: Partner shall maintain at least six (6) Datavane Certified Engineers and one (1) Datavane Certified Architect throughout the Term

findings.title: Automatic annual renewal
findings.why: Locks AtliQ into successive one-year terms automatically, and only Datavane is explicitly stated to give notice of non-renewal.
findings.comparison: Creates an indefinite commitment unless actively monitored for non-renewal.
findings.quote: thereafter renews automatically for successive one (1) year periods unless Datavane gives notice of non-renewal

findings.title: One-sided IP infringement indemnity by Datavane
findings.why: Only Datavane's platform is covered, while Partner faces extensive uncapped indemnity under 11.1.
findings.comparison: Contrasts with AtliQ's preference for mutual indemnities.
findings.quote: Datavane shall defend Partner against any third-party claim alleging that the Platform... infringes a United States patent or copyright...

findings.title: Asymmetric assignment rights
findings.why: Datavane can assign freely while AtliQ is locked in without consent.
findings.comparison: One-sided restriction on AtliQ's corporate flexibility.
findings.quote: Partner may not assign this Agreement... without Datavane's prior written consent. Datavane may assign this Agreement without consent.

findings.title: Indefinite confidentiality for trade secrets and accounts
findings.why: Extends confidentiality obligations beyond the standard 3-year post-termination window for certain categories.
findings.comparison: Most past contracts run 6 to 12 months after the term.
findings.quote: except for trade secrets and information relating to Datavane Accounts, which shall be protected for so long as they remain confidential.
